name: Treant Thicket
description:
Treant Thicket

The bank is characterized by unique guard layout where AI troops are in the vicinty of player's troops.

Value: 9000
Rarity: 80

Size 1: guarded by 4x2 and 2x3 Dendroid Guards, gives 3 Unicorns (15%)
Size 2: guarded by 6x4 Dendroid Guards, gives 5 Unicorns (35%)
Size 3: guarded by 6x6 Dendroid Guards, gives 8 Unicorns (35%)
Size 4: guarded by 6x8 Dendroid Guards, gives 10 Unicorns (15%)

Each troop has a 25% chance to be upgraded.

Treant Thicket substitutes Dragon Fly Hive from the base game.
author: wnukos, Kurek (graphics)
